mode: WAPP (web app with manifest, no service worker)
description: Website wrapper with manifest-driven features — display modes, theme color, scope navigation, no tabs in standalone
launch: ./qapp-ws-wrapper <appId> <url>  (with metadata JSON containing displayMode, scope, themeColor)
note: Same binary as WS mode. Behavior differs based on metadata JSON written at install time.

capabilities.test: Launch installed WAPP app (metadata exists at ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/apps/{appId}.json)
capabilities.expected: WrapperHelper.loadMetadata() reads displayMode, themeColor, scope, startUrl, iconPath. Properties populated.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with manifest start_url=/app/. Launch app.
capabilities.expected: WebEngine loads manifest start_url (not the URL used during install).

capabilities.feature: Standalone mode — no tabs, no save-as-app
capabilities.test: Install WAPP with display:standalone. Launch.
capabilities.expected: No tab bar. No + button. No 'Save as app...' in menu. Hamburger menu only.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with display:minimal-ui. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Header shows back/forward buttons + URL area + hamburger. No tab bar.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with display:fullscreen. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Window starts fullscreen. No header at all. F11 to exit fullscreen shows header.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with display:browser or no display field. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Full browser mode with tabs, save-as-app — same as WS.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with theme_color:#2196f3. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Header background uses #2196f3. Text auto-adjusts (white on dark, dark on light).

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with dark theme_color (e.g., #1a1a2e). Launch.
capabilities.expected: Header text is white (luminance < 0.5 triggers dark mode text).

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with light theme_color (e.g., #f5f5f5). Launch.
capabilities.expected: Header text is dark (luminance >= 0.5 triggers default text color).

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with scope=https://example.com/app/. Click link to /app/page2.
capabilities.expected: Navigation stays in WebEngineView.

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with scope=https://example.com/app/. Click link to https://other.com.
capabilities.expected: Navigation rejected in app. URL opens in system default browser.

capabilities.test: Scope=https://example.com/app/. Navigate to https://example.com/other/ and https://evil.com/app/.
capabilities.expected: Both rejected (wrong path prefix and wrong origin respectively).

capabilities.test: Install WAPP with no scope field. Navigate to any URL.
capabilities.expected: All navigation stays in app (empty scope = unrestricted).

capabilities.test: Launch WAPP with display:standalone
capabilities.expected: Tab bar hidden. Single view only. No + button. No 'Open link in new tab' context menu.

capabilities.test: Launch installed WAPP with icon in metadata
capabilities.expected: Window icon matches installed app icon.

capabilities.test: Resize WAPP window. Close. Relaunch.
capabilities.expected: Window at same position/size.

capabilities.test: Open hamburger menu in standalone WAPP
capabilities.expected: 'Save as app...' not visible (only visible in browser display mode).

capabilities.test: Log in to WAPP. Close. Relaunch.
capabilities.expected: Still logged in.

capabilities.test: Install same site as two different WAPPs. Log in on one.
capabilities.expected: Other instance not logged in. Each appId has its own WebEngine profile.

capabilities.test: Hamburger menu -> Settings (in any display mode)
capabilities.expected: Same settings dialog as WS: cache, heap, UA, clear data.

capabilities.test: Download file in WAPP mode
capabilities.expected: Same behavior as WS: save dialog + progress bar + cancel.

capabilities.test: Switch away >500ms, switch back
capabilities.expected: Resume overlay shows and fades. WebEngine re-activated.
